messages:
maria-cs: FYI customer-42 reported a regression after the 'quant-kernels' deploy — their quantized endpoint is slower than FP16 and sometimes returns garbled tokens. p90 latency jumped from ~180ms to ~470ms for short-chat workloads.

sanjay-runtime: ugh. which model+variant? and did they run with kv-cache enabled?

maria-cs: model: redwood/rw-v2-large, variant: 4bit-q4_0-calib (calibration run done yesterday). KV cache ON (customer uses streaming chat).

kevin-ml: can you paste the customer's request pattern? short prompts, many tokens cached?

maria-cs: they say: ~30 requests/min, prompt len 40 tokens, responses usually 20-50 tokens. Many repeated prefixes (lots of cache hits).

lisa-sre: quick sanity: did the routing fallback pick an INT8 kernel or 4bit specialized one? we saw kernel mismatch causes RPCs to inflate.

sanjay-runtime: attaching profiler snippet from the customer's trace (sanitized):

```
[trace] request_id=R12345 model=rw-v2-large variant=4bit-q4_0-calib
kernel_select: chosen=quant_kern_v3 (per-token switch at token 12)
kv_cache: hit_rate=0.78 calls=23
batching: avg_batch=1.8 window_ms=6
exec: token_latency_ms=14.2(quant_kern_v3)
exec_fp16_equiv: token_latency_ms=3.8(fp16_kern)
net/overhead: rpc_ms=120 total_p99_ms=468
```

sanjay-runtime: tl;dr: quant token kernel is ~3-4x slower than fp16 for this hardware in our build, and combined with many small batches + RPC overhead it explodes p90. Also saw per-token kernel switching when kv cache returned a long prefix => extra state syncs.

kevin-ml: calibration can hurt perf if per-channel ranges cause fallback to slower code paths. what quant backend? we used per-channel symmetric + outlier clamps?

maria-cs: builder used default "auto-calib" flow (calib_config: "fast-pass"), not the long calibration.

lisa-sre: mitigation plan suggestions? customer needs immediate relief.

sanjay-runtime: short-term: 1) route that customer to FP16 fallback (we have a rollout knob) 2) increase batching window to 12ms for their dedicated pool to get avg_batch >4 3) force kernel override to the fp16-compatible path so no per-token switch. All reversible.

tom-support: I'll message the customer: "we've enabled an FP16 fallback and increased the batch window; investigating root cause, will follow up with ETA for a perf-safe 4-bit fix."

kevin-ml: mid-term: redo calibration with "stable-range" profile (more calibration samples, clip-aware optimizer) and re-export quant weights. This should eliminate slow code-paths introduced by edge-range activations.

sanjay-runtime: long-term: we need better kernel-selection heuristics: pick kernels based on steady-state token latency + kv_cache-hit patterns. Also detect per-token kernel switching and avoid stateful syncs by aligning cache chunks to kernel boundaries.

maria-cs: customer asked for ETA for stable fix. how long for new quant build + validation?

kevin-ml: rough: re-calib + build + CI perf run ~ 6-8 hours. validation on regen tests + a canary for 2 hours => ~10-12 hours to be safe.

lisa-sre: I'll open a rollback/override in the routing fabric and pin them to fp16 until canary is green. Assign to @sanjay-runtime and @kevin-ml for root cause + new artifact.

sanjay-runtime: noted. I'll also add telemetry to detect kernel-switch churn: emit metric kernel_switches_per_request and avg_token_latency_by_kernel.

deploy-bot: deploy event: quant-kernels v2025.11.04 applied to infra pool A at 2025-11-04T09:12:03Z

maria-cs: customer updated: "latency better after FP16 routing, but we need to know if 4-bit will be safe long-term." I told them we will follow up with perf numbers and suggested calibration re-run.

kevin-ml: next actions: (1) reproduce in internal perf lab with same prompt distribution + kv-cache ON (sanjay), (2) try calibration profiles and compare token exec latency (kevin), (3) prepare rollback docs and customer comms (maria/tom).

lisa-sre: assign incident P2 and tag eng-runtime + eng-ml. update channel if anything changes. :thumbsup:

maria-cs: thanks all — I'll update customer immediately and close loop when canary completes.

sanjay-runtime: started a perf replay job, job id=perf-7862, ETA ~3h. will post traces here when done.

kevin-ml: started calibration rerun with 'stable-range' config, will push qartifact to staging when ready.

maria-cs: closing note for thread: prioritize customer availability over 4-bit cost savings until we have deterministic perf for streaming+kv_cache workloads.
